key_findings.S76_correction: S76 120-degree balanced triad was misclassified. R=0.997 means in-phase, not 120 degrees.
key_findings.coupling_sign_determines_pattern: Attractive coupling -> in-phase. Repulsive coupling -> splay state.
key_findings.S74_match: REPULSIVE coupling matches S74 observations (C_corr=-0.694, delta_phi=178 deg, PLI=0.993)
key_findings.splay_law: 2pi/N splay state holds for N=2,3 (repulsive) but spacing error increases for N>=4
key_findings.collective_coherence: Repulsive coupling collapses C_collective to ~0.33, far below phi_inverse=0.618
key_findings.competition_radius: Smooth transition from in-phase (r=0.1pi) to dispersed (r=0.9pi) in competitive regime

regime_comparison.attractive: IN_PHASE for all N (R>0.99), positive C correlations
regime_comparison.repulsive: SPLAY for N=2,3, DISPERSED for N>=4 (R<0.09), negative C correlations for N=2
regime_comparison.competitive: CLUSTERED for all N (R~0.87), positive C correlations
